summary_en: Sompo Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 15 million shares (1.70% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 68.0 billion yen from December 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The company simultaneously approved cancellation of 49.67 million shares (5.32% of issued shares before cancellation) effective November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice on the Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Sompo Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 15.0 million treasury shares, representing 1.70% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum outlay of 68.0 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from December 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The authorization reflects the company's capital allocation policy, which combines base shareholder returns equivalent to 50% of three-year average adjusted net profit with supplementary returns from 50% of after-tax gains on strategic shareholding disposals. The company also adjusts its capital level based on risk and capital position, business performance, and financial market conditions, with share buybacks serving as one option alongside dividends.

Simultaneously, the board approved cancellation of 49.67 million treasury shares, representing 5.32% of issued shares before cancellation, effective November 30, 2026. This cancellation will reduce the issued share count to 884.56 million shares.
